Name: On, Son of Peleth
Summary: On, son of Peleth, was a Reubenite who joined Korah's rebellion against Moses and Aaron.
KeyStory: On rose up with Korah, Dathan, and Abiram against Moses in the wilderness, and is named no more after the rebellion.
RelatedPeople: Dathan; Abiram; Peleth; Korah, Son of Izhar; Moses
LifeLesson: Joining a rebellion is a choice with a name attached to it.
